title: Idle Speed Control (ISC) Valve
ocr_text:
Idle Speed Control (ISC) Valve

[DIAGRAM showing Rotor, Coil, Valve Shaft, Valve components and electrical schematic with S1, B1, S3, R2, S2, S4 connections to Rotor]

CHECK FOR OPERATING SOUND FROM ISC VALVE

Check that there is a clicking sound immediately after stopping the engine.

[DIAGRAM F16216 showing hand checking ISC valve with ear symbol]

REMOVAL OF ISC VALVE

1. DRAIN COOLANT

2. DISCONNECT ISC VALVE CONNECTOR

3. DISCONNECT NO.2 WATER BY-PASS HOSE AND AIR HOSE

[DIAGRAM F16217 showing disconnection of hoses]

4. REMOVE ISC VALVE
(a) Remove the two bolts, ISC valve and gasket.
(b) Disconnect the No.1 water by-pass hose from the ISC valve.
(c) (7M-GTE)
Remove the seal washer and check valve from the air intake chamber.

[DIAGRAM F16218 showing ISC valve removal]
